svg.aria-label: From a change to a release. make check runs gofmt, vet and staticcheck for Linux and Windows, shellcheck and go test -race. make test-windows runs every package again as a Windows program, started from WSL. CI runs both, with fuzzing and govulncheck, builds the zips and the demo image, tests on Windows Server 2022 and 2025 and Windows 11 on ARM, stops real distributions on WSL 2, and runs the installers; weekly too. A vX.Y.Z tag runs CI, then builds the zips with provenance, the Scoop manifest and the demo image, then installs the release as you, as a standard user and with Scoop.
